result.title: Can Language Models Play the Wikipedia Game?
result.comment: 64 pages (14-page main text, references and 16 appendices), 17 figures, 10 tables
result.summary: Language models increasingly support or automate information retrieval from document collections too large to index. This task is difficult when it requires specialist linguistic or scientific knowledge. We used the Wikipedia Game to test language models on an analogous information retrieval task. In the game, players must reach a target article using only article links. We compared sentence embedding models and LLMs across five Wikipedia languages and five academic-literature datasets. We construct very large local graphs of Wikipedia pages and of paper citations using OpenAlex and provide code to build and navigate them. This allows the study of language models' navigation capabilities without relying on third-party APIs. We compared the models with human and TF-IDF benchmarks. The Wikipedia Game format enables robust comparisons across techniques, languages, and domains. No model significantly outperformed humans, although the best models (GPT-o3 mini, GPT-4o, QwQ:32B, and DeepSeek-R1:70B) achieved comparable success. Performance and rankings varied across languages and topics, with implications for practitioners utilising these techniques.

AI.brief_summary: 论文以「维基百科游戏」（只能沿条目链接走到目标页面）作为信息检索任务，在五种语言与五个学术文献数据集上比较句向量模型和多个 LLM 的导航能力，并以人类与 TF-IDF 为基线，另构建本地维基与 OpenAlex 引用图；结论是没有模型显著优于人类，表现随语言和主题变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 多步图导航涉及逐步选择证据与何时停止，可能与 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 取舍及动态计算评价有概念性联系，可供核查；但该任务为纯文本检索、不涉及内部 latent 状态或视觉证据，可迁移线索有限。
